components.name: Nav Theme Toggle
components.description: Interactive theme toggle from the top navigation.
components.css: .ds-theme-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #2a2a30; background: #141419; color: #999999; cursor: pointer; transition: all 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-theme-toggle:hover { border-color: #e07b3c; color: #e07b3c; background: rgba(224, 123, 60, 0.15); }

narrative.overview: This system is modern yet recognizable, built to reflect a thoughtful, un-rushed approach to interface creation. It avoids unnecessary decoration, letting the structure and typography do the heavy lifting. The copywriting is simple to understand but precise, using the right jargon where necessary to signal expertise. We explicitly reject "AI slop"—thoughtlessly generated templates, generic SaaS tropes, or chaotic overstuffed layouts.
keyCharacteristics: Purposeful use of technical monospaced accents

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Warm Rust is the only brand color. Never introduce secondary or tertiary hues. If it's not Warm Rust, it's a neutral.

rules.name: The Mono Metadata Rule
rules.body: Dates, technical tags, and code-adjacent labels must use JetBrains Mono to reinforce the "precision engineer" aesthetic.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is conveyed entirely through tonal shifts and structural borders, never through drop shadows or blurs.

dos: Do ensure every element on the screen earns its place. Precision over noise.
Do use typography scale and weight contrast (not color) to establish hierarchy.
Do write copy that is simple, yet technically precise.
donts: Don't use drop shadows. The system is flat.
Don't use generic SaaS tropes or chaotic overstuffed layouts ("AI slop").
Don't use glassmorphism as a default decoration (only functional blurs, like the sticky nav).
